questions.question: Who among the following was honoured with Bharat Ratna award before becoming the President of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**S Radhakrishnan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was honored with the Bharat Ratna in 1954, before becoming the President of India in 1962.**
 
• Dr. Radhakrishnan **was an acclaimed philosopher and an expert on Indian philosophy. **
 
• His works helped bridge Eastern and Western philosophical traditions.
 
• His birthday, September 5, is celebrated as **Teachers' Day** in India to honor his contributions to education and his belief in the value of teaching.
 
• **Before becoming President, he served as the first Vice President of India (1952–1962).**
 
• **He also represented India as an ambassador to UNESCO and the Soviet Union.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajendra Prasad****​**

 
 
• Rajendra Prasad was the longest-serving President of India (1950 to 1962).
 
• Rajendra Prasad was elected as the first President of India on 24th January 1950
 
• He was one of the prominent leaders of the Indian independence movement and played a prominent role as the President of the Indian National Congress. 
 
 
• During his tenure, H.C. Mookerjee was the Vice-President.
 
 
 
• ​He was a lawyer by profession, and also an influential leader during the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• He served as the president of the Constituent Assembly that drafted the first constitution of the Republic of India, which lasted from 1948 to 1950.
 
• He also became the first Minister of Food and Agriculture in 1946 in the Interim National Government.
 
 
 
• V. V. Giri:
 
 
• Varahagiri Venkata Giri was the 4th president of India from 24 August 1969 to 24 August 1974.
 
• He was the only president to be elected as an independent candidate.
 
• He was succeeded by Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed as president in 1974.
 
• After the end of his full term, Giri was honored by the Government of India with the Bharat Ratna in 1975.
 
• V. V. Giri was closely associated with the labor and trade union movement in India throughout his career.
 
• V. V. Giri was a founding member of the All India Railwaymen's Federation which was formed in 1923 and served as its general secretary for over a decade.
 
• He was elected president of the All India Trade Union Congress for the first time in 1926.
 
• V. V. Giri also founded the Bengal Nagpur Railway Association and in 1928 led the workers of the Bengal Nagpur Railway in a non-violent strike for the rights of retrenched workers.
 
 
 
• **Pranab mukherjee****​**
 
 
• Pranab Mukherjee served as 13th President of India from 25th July 2012 till 25th July 2017.
 
• He was honoured with India's highest civilian honour, the Bharat Ratna in 2019 by incumbent President Ram Nath Kovind.
 
• Mukherjee had served as the Defence Minister from 2004-2006, External Affairs from 2006-2009, and the Union Minister of Finance from 2009 to 2012 before he was elected President.
 
• The Prime Minister PV Narasimha Rao appointed Mukherjee as the head of the Planning Commission in 1991 and Foreign Minister in 1995.
 
 

70:T

questions.question: The ‘Polly Umrigar Award’ is conferred in which sports category?

Read the given statements and select the correct option.

Statement I: Only Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan and C Rajagopalachari were the first recipients of the Bharat Ratna.

Statements II: Sachin Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, and he remains the first and only cricketer to have received this honor till 2024

options.text: Statement I is incorrect, while statement II is correct.
Both statement I and statement II are correct.
Statement I is correct, while statement II is incorrect.
Both statement I and statement II are incorrect.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Statement I is incorrect:** Because the first Bharat Ratna awardees were **three persons** in 1954 — C. Rajagopalachari, S. Radhakrishnan, and C.V. Raman.
 
• **Statement II is correct:** Sachin Tendulkar was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, and he is the first and only cricketer to receive this honor as of 2024.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna:**

 
 
• It is the highest civilian award in India.
 
• Established in 1954, it is awarded for exceptional service towards the advancement of Art, Literature and Science, and in recognition of Public Service of the highest order.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant but a certificate (Sanad) signed by the President and a medallion.
 
 
 
• **Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan:**
 
 
• He was an Indian philosopher and statesman who served as the first Vice President of India and the second President of India.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954 for his contribution to education and philosophy.
 
 
 
• **C. Rajagopalachari:**
 
 
• He was an Indian politician, independence activist, lawyer, writer, and statesman.
 
• He was the last Governor-General of India and a founder of the Swatantra Party.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1954 for his public service.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar:**
 
 
• He is a former Indian cricketer and one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2014, making him the youngest recipient and the first sportsperson to receive the award.

questions.question: The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize is annually awarded for outstanding achievement in which area?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Science and Technology.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar**

 
 
• The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Science and Technology Award (SSB) is a **scientific award **awarded annually in India **by the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)** for outstanding and outstanding **research, and application in biology, chemistry, environmental science, engineering, mathematics, medicine, and physics.**
 
• Bhatnagar was the founding director of the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (**CSIR**), later becoming a significant independent research body in India.
 
• He was the first chair of the University Grants Committee (**UGC**).
 
• He served as secretary of the Ministry of Education and as an education advisor to the government.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The award is named after the founder Director of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR) India, the late Dr. (Sir) Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar and is known as the ‘Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (SSB) Prize for Science and Technology.
 
• SSB Prizes, each of value of Rs 5,00,000 (Rupees five lakh only), are awarded annually for notable and outstanding research, applied or fundamental, in the following disciplines:
 
 
• Biological Sciences
 
• Chemical Sciences
 
• Earth, Atmosphere
 
• Ocean and Planetary Sciences
 
• Engineering Sciences
 
• Mathematical Sciences
 
• Medical Sciences
 
• Physical Sciences.

questions.question: The first Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was given to whom?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Viswanathan Anand.**__

__
 
• **Viswanathan Anand** was the first recipient of the award.
 
• He was honoured for the performance in the year** 1991–92**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

**About Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**

__
 
• It is the **highest sporting honour of India.**
 
• The recipient(s) is/are honoured for their outstanding performance in the field of sports over a period of four years at an international level.
 
• It was instituted in **1991–92.**
 
• The award comprises a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize of Rs 25 lakh.
 
• **Abhinav Bindra** is the youngest recipient of the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• For the year 2020 **five sportspersons** received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna on the occasion of the National Sports Day on 29th August.

questions.question: Who was the first woman to win Sahitya Akademi Award in 1956?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**​Amrita Pritam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amrita Pritam** was an Indian novelist, essayist and poet, who wrote in Punjabi and Hindi.
 
• She was born as Amrita Kaur on 31 August 1919, in **Gujranwala, Punjab **in undivided British India.
 
• As British India was divided into Independent India and Pakistan, Amrita moved from Lahore to New Delhi.
 
• She is most remembered for her poignant poem, Aj Aakhaan Waris Shah Nu (Today I invoke Waris Shah – “Ode to Waris Shah”), an elegy to the 18th-century Punjabi poet, an expression of her anguish over massacres during the partition of India.
 
• Her first anthology of poems, **Amrit Lehran **(Immortal Waves) was published in** 1936** when she was sixteen years old.
 
• Amrita worked at ‘Lahore Radio Station’ until partition. In India, she worked with ‘All India Radio’.
 
• **Awards & Achievements-**
 
 
• **The Punjab Rattan Award **by the government of Punjab is awarded to achievers in the field of art, literature, science, technology, culture, and politics. Amrita was the first to receive it.
 
• **Amrita was the first woman** to win the renowned Sahitya Akademi Award award. **She won in 1956 for her poem ‘Sunehade’ (Messages)**. The poem is considered to be her magnum opus.
 
• One of India’s highest literary awards, the **Bhartiya Jnanpith Award **was given to her in **1982** for ‘**Kagaj te Canvas’** (Paper and Canvas).
 
• She is also the recipient of the **Padma Vibhushan**, India’s second-highest civilian award, in** 2004.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
